$description: Citation permalink resolution (CAP-RW-04, UX-12; ASR-E06 from PR #54; review E7-E9). Reference implementation: app/importer/mimamsa_importer/importer.py cite(). Tested by app/design/tests/test_citation_resolution.py and app/importer/tests.

CITED_COPY_ELIGIBLE_NOT_CURRENT.notice: This copy is not the current edition in the library.
CITED_COPY_ELIGIBLE_NOT_CURRENT.note: Held and verified in an earlier generation, not withdrawn or restricted (vault retains prior copies).

CITED_COPY_UNAVAILABLE.notice: The cited copy is not available in this installation.
CITED_COPY_UNAVAILABLE.note: One indistinguishable response (security §7.3 non-disclosure). No date, reason, restriction id or current-edition offer, because offering one would reveal that the copy existed. Admins see the reason in the Admin audit/withdrawal view only.

CITED_PAGE_NOT_IN_COPY.notice: The cited page does not exist in the cited copy.

AMBIGUOUS_REFERENCE.notice: The citation does not identify a single copy. Use the full reference.

REFERENCE_MISMATCH.notice: The citation's document and copy do not match.

permalink_release_id: Informational: records where the citation was made. Resolution uses the full copy hash only (prefix must match exactly one held, non-excluded copy).
held_copies: Copies of activated generations only (at or below the ACTIVE release sequence); a never-activated generation's copies are not citable.
